{{Legacy|untradeable=y}} {{Infobox/Item |rarity = special |lore = A truly remarkable pencil. Refined, sharpened and polished over time.
Given to those who went above and beyond. |tradeable = n |auctionable = n |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special |id = EDITOR_PENCIL |soulbound = Co-op }} The '''Editor's Pencil''' is a {{Special}} item. == Obtaining == The '''Editor's Pencil''' is an item rewarded to editors of the Official Hypixel Wiki who went 'above and beyond'. == Usage == The '''Editor's Pencil''' used to send a link in chat to a random random page on the Official Hypixel Wiki. This functionality was later removed. == Game Messages == {|class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Message |- | Right-clicking the Pencil (before the Official Wiki's closure) | {{Dialogue|&7Click &e&lHERE &7to see a random Wiki page!}} |} == Trivia == *{{RN|mvp++|Messisteve}} invented the lore of the '''Editor's Pencil'''. *The '''Editor's Pencil''' was originally going to be called the '''Ancient Pencil''', but was renamed in late 2021. == See also == *{{Item|Wiki Journal}} == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2022/March 30|link=none|[[File:Enchanted Feather.png|26px]] Added '''Editor's Pencil'''.}} {{History|2024/February 6|Changed rarity from {{Very Special}} to {{Special}}.}} {{History|2026/July 21|Removed the right-click ability.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Special Items}}
